author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Launch Window: June 12th from 8:27AM to 12:27AM EDT (12:27-16:27 UTC)
Current T0: June 12th at 8:27AM EDT (12:27 UTC)

Mission: Falcon 9 launch of 29 Starlink v2 Mini satellites into orbit.
Launch location: Space Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40), Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Earth.
Target orbit: Low-Earth Orbit (LEO)
Booster: B1080-27; 59d 2h 53min 50s turnaround
Past customer missions: Axiom-2, Euclid, Axiom-3, CRS-30, SES-24, NG-21.
Past Starlink missions: 6-11, 6-24, 6-52, 6-62, 10-10, 6-69, 12-1, 12-2, 12-4, 10-12, 6-80, 6-75, 10-32, 10-16, 10-30, 10-15, 6-78, 6-100, 10-40, 10-24.
Satellites launched: 521, will be 550 after this mission.
Booster recovery: A Shortfall Of Gravitas (ASOG)
Fairing recovery: Bob
Rocket trajectory: Northeast flying parallel to the US east coast
Payload mass: Approximately 17 tonnes.
Stats:
  - SpaceX's 679th launch overall.
  - SpaceX's 70th launch of the year.
  - SpaceX's 6th launch of the month.
  - Earth's 137th orbital launch of the year.
  - Falc
title: SpaceX Launches Falcon 9 with Starlink 10-54
